# Module 04 · Git history

> 4 lessons · about 75 minutes · run every command from the course folder

| # | Lesson | What you learn |
|---|---|---|
| 13 | [git log](13-git-log/README.md) | How to read the history: the full log, the one-line view, the graph of branches, and how to filter it by author, message, date and file. |
| 14 | [git show](14-git-show/README.md) | How to inspect one commit: its metadata and its changes, a summary of the files it touched, and a file exactly as it was in that commit. |
| 15 | [git diff](15-git-diff/README.md) | How to compare any two versions: your edits, what is staged, two commits, two branches; and how to read the diff format itself. |
| 16 | [Commit history visualization](16-history-visualization/README.md) | How to see history as what it really is: a graph of commits pointing to their parents, with branches as labels on some of them. We draw it, then… |

Then test yourself: [assessment](assessment.md) (quiz, practical challenge, troubleshooting challenge, real-world scenario).
